items.label: LG Energy Solution DART supply contract (10-01-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Customer Hanwha Q CELLS USA Corp: correction filing (filed 10-01-2026)

set.signal: Customer Hanwha Q CELLS USA Corp: correction filing (filed 10-01-2026) releasing the withheld contract amount of the 'ESS battery supply contract' signed 05-16-2024 -- a contract to supply a total of 4.8GWh of ESS (Energy Storage System) batteries to Hanwha Q CELLS USA Corp, supply region United States, term 05-16-2024 to 10-01-2026. With the project's supply term ended and the withholding period (business confidentiality) expired, the amount is disclosed as KRW 1,281,310,030,251 -- the total of the foreign-currency sales over the supply term, converted at Hana Bank's first-posted rate of KRW 1,355.7/USD on the correction filing date -- 3.8% of revenue (KRW 33,745,469,740,463, 2023 year-end consolidated). No down payment or advance.
set.figure: KRW 1,281,310,030,251 (total sales over the supply term), 3.8% of 2023 revenue; contract for a total of 4.8GWh of ESS batteries; 05-16-2024 to 10-01-2026

items.reason: The filing states a contract TO SUPPLY a total of 4.8GWh; it does not state that 4.8GWh were supplied, and the disclosed amount is the actual sales total over the term, not a price for 4.8GWh.
items.evidence: Hanwha Q CELLS USA Corp에 대하여 총 4.8GWh 규모의 ESS(Energy Storage System) 배터리를 공급하는 계약을 체결하는 건 ... 공급 계약 기간 동안의 외화 매출 실적 금액의 총 합계
